title: ET Exclusive: Flipkart’s former suites write to Walmart board, seek fair treatment and full cash out of vested ESOPs
excerpt: A group of former senior Flipkart executives has urged Walmart to buy back their vested stock options. This request comes after the company's plans for an initial public offering have been postponed again. Recent leadership changes at Flipkart have highlighted ongoing tensions between former executives and current management. The signatories argue that those who contributed to Flipkart's success deserve liquidity opportunities.

title: Seven Tata Trusts file slew of caveats with Maharashtra Charity Chief
excerpt: Seven trusts under Tata Trusts have filed caveats to be heard ahead of any orders by the Maharashtra Charity Commissioner. Venu Srinivasan and Vijay Singh have raised concerns about governance issues surrounding Noel Tata's leadership. These issues include questions regarding decision-making and participation restrictions in Tata Sons matters. The filings follow existing restrictions on the Sir Ratan Tata Trust's functioning and meetings.

title: Best online deals to have short life as brands battle surging input costs
excerpt: During this festive period, ecommerce platforms are gearing up to provide enticing discounts for just the first few days.
